messages:
incident-bot: [PAGE] prod us-west-2: spike in gateway timeouts for /v1/generate — 5xx rate 3.7% over 3m (threshold 1.2%) :rotating_light:
Rina: grabbing this. jumping in.
deploy-bot: No deploys in last 3h (pipeline: main).
Tom B: any known upstream incidents? I can check peering & provider health.
Kara: I'm seeing increased upstream connect timeouts to Provider-B around 09:11-09:18. pulling logs now.
Rina: sample curl to proxy returning 504: `curl -v -X POST https://prod-us-west2.proxy.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"hello"}'` response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Shawn: looks like gateway timeouts rather than model runtime 5xx. adding `upstream.connect_timeout` and `upstream.read_timeout` counters to quick view.
Nora: opened temporary incident channel #inc-1876549877 and pinged #customer-ops with note: "short spike in 504s for /v1/generate in us-west-2; mitigated by traffic shift; may affect high-concurrency clients."
Rina: performing traffic shift to reduce weight on Provider-B. will shift 50% to fallback cluster (prov-A + internal pool).
Rina: command: `edgectl route patch runtime-proxy --region us-west-2 --set weight.providerB=50 weight.fallback=50`
OpsBot: edgectl: change accepted, applied to 4 edge nodes.
Tom B: 5xx rate down to 1.1% within 90s. good signal.
Kara: starting a short capture of gateway logs for the 5m window to surface error patterns. query: `level:error service:gateway path:/v1/generate status:5.. origin:upstream`
Shawn: suggestion: current alert is noisy because small tenants trigger it frequently. propose we change alert to only page when either: (a) >75 errors in 5m OR (b) 5xx rate >2% for 4m. keeps sensitivity for larger incidents.
Nora: +1. also let's add an annotation to the alert to list affected orgs count and top-3 org ids. that helps SRE decide if it's a page.
Rina: I've muted the alert for 20m while we stabilize. mute-id M-1876549877-1.
OpsBot: ALERT_MUTED by Rina (20m)
Tom B: follow-up: create dashboard tile showing provider error ratio and p95 upstream latency per provider. I'll add to the incident board and link it.
Tom B: added panel: "us-west-2 provider error ratio" on incident dashboard https://graf.redwood/board/1876549877-inc (internal)
Kara: captured traces show timeouts on connections to Provider-B backend during TLS handshake retries. forwarding to infra-team that owns provider peering.
Shawn: for longer term, we should add an automated failover play: if provider-level 5xx ratio > 2% for 3m, auto-decrease weight by 40% and trigger a runbook step to notify infra.
Rina: creating INFRA-2399 to track permanent alert tweak + automated weight shift + dashboard. assigning to Shawn + Tom.
Nora: drafting brief customer message for CS: "We observed a transient spike of gateway timeouts affecting high-concurrency requests to /v1/generate in us-west-2 between 09:11-09:20 UTC. We shifted traffic away from the affected upstream provider which restored normal service. We're working on alert tuning and automated failover to prevent noisy paging."
Shawn: propose promql for the alert change:
Shawn: ```
ALERT runtime_gateway_5xx_high
IF: (sum(rate(runtime_proxy_http_status{code=~"5..",path="/v1/generate",region="us-west-2"}[4m])) > 75) OR (sum(rate(runtime_proxy_http_status{code=~"5..",path="/v1/generate",region="us-west-2"}[4m])) / sum(rate(runtime_proxy_requests_total{path="/v1/generate",region="us-west-2"}[4m])) > 0.02)
FOR: 4m
LABELS: severity=page, team=eng-oncall
```
Nora: add annotation: `affected_orgs_count`, `top_orgs`, `auto_failover_allowed=true/false`
Tom B: also add a secondary alert for upstream latency: `upstream_tls_retry_count` or p95 latency > 2.5s FOR 5m with severity=page-warning.
Rina: handoff note: I'm offline in 25m. Nora will be primary for the post-incident follow-ups. if page escalates, page Shawn then Tom.
Nora: acknowledged. I'll take INFRA-2399 and coordinate dashboards/runbook edits. ETA EOD.
Kara: closing loop from logs: provider B showed intermittent SYN timeout then multiple connection retries; infra notified.
OpsBot: INCIDENT UPDATED: inc=INC-1876549877 status=mitigated mitigated_by=traffic-shift timestamp=1876550477
Rina: current 5xx rate is 0.2% for last 15m; marking mitigated.
Shawn: notes for postmortem: (1) alert too sensitive for low-volume noisy endpoints, (2) need automated provider-level failover logic, (3) add provider TLS/retry metrics to incident board.
Nora: I'll run the follow-ups: update alert rules, create dashboard tiles, add playbook entry for automated weight adjustments, and draft a short post-incident note to link to INFRA-2399.
Rina: thanks team. good catch and quick mitigation. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
